title: Car Fleet
summary: Cars drive toward the same target along a road.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100,000 cars. Target is in [1, 1,000,000]. Starting positions are distinct integers from 0 through target − 1. Each speed is in [1, 1,000,000]. The position and speed arrays have equal length, with matching zero-based indices for each car.

statement: Cars drive toward the same target along a road. A car cannot pass one ahead. If it catches a car or fleet ahead, they travel together at the slower fleet's speed. Cars that first meet exactly at the target count together. Return the number of fleets arriving at the target.

examples.explanation: The first two cars reach the target at time 2 together. The last car arrives later.
With equal speeds, the cars keep their original gaps.
All cars would reach the target at the same time.

constraints: 1–100,000 cars. Target is in [1, 1,000,000]. Starting positions are distinct integers from 0 through target − 1. Each speed is in [1, 1,000,000]. The position and speed arrays have equal length, with matching zero-based indices for each car.
hints: Conceptual: The car closest to the target sets the first fleet's arrival time.
Directional: Process cars from closest to farthest and compare their unobstructed arrival times.
Implementation: A time less than or equal to the latest fleet time joins that fleet. Otherwise count a new fleet. Compare integer fractions by cross-multiplication.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) auxiliary space when sorting an array of cars. The scan after sorting is linear.
